sn37.2:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato puriso ekantaamanāpo hoti mātugāmassa || katamehi pañcahi || || Na ca rūpavā hoti || na ca bhogavā hoti || na ca sīlavā hoti || alaso ca hoti || pajañcassa na labhati || || Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato puriso ekanta-amanāpo hoti mātugāmassa Pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato puriso ekantamanāpo hoti mātugāmassa || katamehi pañcahi || || Rūpavā ca hoti || bhogavā ca hoti || silavā ca hoti || dakkho ca hoti analaso || pajañcassa labhati || || Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato puriso ekantamanāpo hoti mātugāmassāti || ||
